subject: Request: Executive approval for Hosted API concession (MedixLab)
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@medixlab.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medixlab.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API estimate and commercial ask

Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The team is excited by the latency and the usage profile you showed. We ran a quick internal forecast and, to make this work for our margins, we need a deeper price concession than the standard published hosted rates.

High level ask: 18-month commitment with 6M tokens/mo average and a 3M token burst pool. To be viable we need a 35% off list rate for the hosted usage line item. We can accelerate deployment and sign a Statement of Work in Q1 if we can land that band.

I attached a short summary of our usage profile and the draft SOW. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support this level of concession and any guardrails you would require?

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
VP Platform & Data, MedixLab
(sanjay.rao@medixlab.com)

Attachments referenced: MedixLab_MOAP.pdf
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API estimate and commercial ask / need exec guidance

Team — forwarding MedixLab's ask. TL;DR: request for 35% off hosted usage in exchange for an 18-month commitment and specific burst allowances. They are a high-quality prospect (healthcare analytics) and this ramps quickly if we can meet price.

Background: MedixLab's forecast shows steady 6M tokens/mo with predictable peaks. Occupies premium support corridor given PHI adjacency; they'd be on Dedicated at scale but are prioritizing hosted for speed to production.

My read: 35% is above standard discretionary threshold. I think we can offer an elevated concession if coupled with either a higher commit or a temporary ramp credit structure + strict overage tiers. Proposed counter (quick): 25% off list for first 12 months with a performance clause (if avg tokens >= 6M for months 4-6, convert to 30% for remaining term) and baked-in burst charge at a premium rate.

Requesting: Ben or Mina — can one of you authorize up to 25% today to unblock contracting and commit to a further exec review for uplift to 30% pending Q1 usage? If we approve only 25% I will present the structured fallback to Medix. If you think 25% is too high I need guidance on the ceiling we can offer immediately.

Attachments: Pricing_Model_v3.xlsx (my counter numbers).

Thanks,
Tessa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API estimate and commercial ask / need exec guidance

Tessa —

Appreciate the framing and the quick counter. I reviewed the pricing model and the account fit. MedixLab is strategic for our health vertical push and the deal velocity here is attractive. I’m willing to clear an immediate concession up to 25% off list for the hosted usage line to allow legal and contracting to move forward. Conditions:

- 18-month committed term (no opt-outs in first 6 months)
- Minimum monthly commit confirmed in contract (6M tokens/mo)
- Burst pool allowed but billed at 1.5x marginal rate beyond committed pool
- Audit clause + SOC2 boundary language in SOW to address PHI adjacency
- Discount subject to a mid-term usage review at month 6 for potential uplift to 30% (requires exec re-approval)

I can sign the internal approval note for 25% now. Mina — do you want to review for final pricing/legal flags? If not, Tessa, proceed to Legal/Contracts and present the 25% structure. If MedixLab presses for more, we'll need a Board-level exec note and a clear business case for moving above 25%.

Ben
VP, Strategic Accounts
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-09T17:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API estimate and commercial ask / need exec guidance

Per Ben's note — I reviewed contract flags and the SOW. Legal is fine with the audit and SOC2 boundary language; finance confirms the 25% concession with the committed volume is acceptable from an NPV perspective given the expected ARR profile.

Formal approval: Mina Haddad (Finance) signs off for an immediate 25% hosted-usage concession under the conditions below. This is an exception to the standard pricing matrix and requires documentation in Deal Desk notes.

Conditions attached to approval:
- 18-month firm commitment at 6M tokens/mo minimum (as written in the MSA)
- Burst usage allowed but charged at 1.5x above the committed marginal rate
- Discount applies only to the hosted usage SKU (other add-ons priced separately)
- 6-month operational review; if utilization hits target thresholds, Sales may escalate to execs for a one-time uplift to 30%
- Deal Desk to capture revised pricing in HubSpot and route for Legal signature with SOC2 appendix

Mina Haddad
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Forwarding this to Marissa to coordinate contract redlines and to Tessa to share with MedixLab.

Attachments: Medix_QBR_2026.pptx (background on account strategic fit)
